claims.claim_ar: أداة جواب/توكيد تستخدم للإيجاب والتأكيد (نعم/بلَى) لا للدلالة على البلاء أو الابتلاء
claims.claim_en: An affirmative/response particle used for assent and emphasis ('indeed/yes'), not to be confused with the noun 'بَلاء' (affliction).

warnings: Most target words in this ayah (e.g., كَسَبَ، سَيِّئَةً، أَحَاطَتْ، خَطِيئَتُهُ، أَصْحَابُ، النَّارِ، خَالِدُونَ) do not appear as exact substrings or are not discussed in the provided source chunks, so only morphology claims supported directly by the given sources are extracted (here: بَلَى). If you want claims for other words, provide source material that contains those words or explicit morphological discussion of them.
